name: Alzheimer's Association Research Fellowship for All (AARFA)
amount: Up to USD 200,000 (up to USD 180,000 research budget, max USD 70,000/year, plus USD 20,000 dissemination stipend)
other_rules: Open to US and international researchers
within 10 years of the terminal doctorate at LOI
must not hold an independent faculty position at award
notes: Replaces the former AARF. LOI 14 Aug 2026, full application 20 Oct 2026, awards by 30 Jan 2027. 2-3 years; indirect costs capped at 10%.
